title: SGP grading addendum — 2026-11-17 slate (2026-11-17 and 2026-11-18 games)

rules.single: grade from published pick_line text "TEAM -x.x": cover if team wins by more than x.x, PUSH at exactly x.x, else LOSS; units paper -110 (WIN +1.00, LOSS -1.10, PUSH 0.00); gate failures NO BET 0.00
rules.parlay: every leg must WIN; any losing leg loses stake 1.10; WIN pays the published fair-odds band lower bound
rules.sgp: legs are player props (Over/Under). A leg whose player did not play is VOID and removed; remaining legs settle at the ticket price frozen at publication (joint_prob_rho as fair price; G-PROP blocked, no market price). Any losing leg loses the stake (1.10).
rules.finals_source: data/official/results_2026-11-14.json — official game pages (LINESCORES), quarters sum to finals (asserted at capture)

legs.evidence: official box-score page for 0022600256 (2026-11-17 CHA@LAL, FINAL 118-114): Dončić 42:20, 13-34 FG, 5-16 3PT, 5-7 FT, 7 REB, 7 AST, 1 STL, 1 BLK, 5 TO, 5 PF, +2 — 36 points. 36 <= 38.5, so the OVER loses. (The game page's own recap sentence “After scoring at least 40 points in seven games already this season, Luka Doncic took a back seat with 36” agrees with the box row, so the leg does not rest on recap text.)

the same official box-score page closes with an “Inactive Players” block printing “LAL: Chris Manon, Austin Reaves, Walker Kessler, Arthur Kaluma”, and Reaves has no row in the Lakers table; the official gamebook for the same game (fetched in this session) gives the reason: “Reaves (Injury/Illness - Left Heel Contusion / Bone Bruise)”. A leg whose player did not appear is VOID and removed under the frozen rule.

validation_note: Paper, unfunded, zero-stake output. Every ticket here was published as MODEL OUTPUT — UNVALIDATED; grading it does not make any strategy funded.

flags.item: Curry's VOID leg rests on the gamebook inactive list, not on a re-read of the box page's own Inactive Players block.
flags.detail: the gamebook is the same official source class this repo used to grade the 2026-11-16 slate's props, and Curry has no row in the box-score table either, so the grade is not in doubt; it is recorded here because the evidence grade differs from the other three VOID/loss legs, which cite the box-score page directly

flags.item: No market price exists for these tickets, so the WIN payout is the frozen +1.10 convention, not a priced number.
flags.detail: the frozen joint probability under the measured rho (printed beside each ticket as frozen_price_joint_prob_rho) is the model's own number; with no sportsbook price in this repository a won ticket cannot be paid at anything but the convention the 2026-11-16 SGP addendum used
